about.pageDescription: UniQer — a campus tour platform across universities of Kazakhstan
about.heading: About UniQer
about.intro: We help students in Kazakhstan make an informed choice about their future career through immersion in student life
about.missionText: To make choosing a university an informed and exciting process. We believe that every student deserves the opportunity to see firsthand where they will study, meet students and faculty, and experience the atmosphere of their future alma mater.
about.value1Desc: We help students make a well-considered choice about their future career based on real experience
about.value2Desc: We believe that choosing the right university is the foundation of a successful career and a fulfilling life
about.value3Desc: We don't just talk about universities — we show them from the inside through the eyes of students
about.whatWeDo1Desc: We organize tours of the best universities in Kazakhstan, visiting academic buildings, labs, and dormitories
about.whatWeDo2Desc: We conduct assessments, seminars, and consultations to help students decide on a career path
about.whatWeDo3Desc: We organize comfortable trips across cities of Kazakhstan with accommodation, meals, and cultural activities
about.ctaTitle: Ready to go on a journey through universities?
about.ctaDesc: Join hundreds of students who have already made an informed choice thanks to our campus tours

contacts.pageDescription: Get in touch with the UniQer team
contacts.heading: Contacts
contacts.subtitle: Reach out to us in any convenient way. We are always happy to answer your questions
contacts.emailDesc: We will reply within a day
contacts.writeUsDesc: Have questions? Fill out the form and we will get back to you shortly.
contacts.faq1Question: How do I sign up for a tour?
contacts.faq1Answer: Choose a suitable tour from the catalog and fill out the application form. We will contact you to confirm.
contacts.faq2Question: What is included in the price?
contacts.faq2Answer: Transportation, accommodation, meals, campus visits, and all scheduled activities. Details are listed on each tour page.
contacts.faq3Answer: Yes, we offer special rates for school groups. Contact us for a personalized quote.
